text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The showdown of a lifetime to decide the 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And claiming victory in this battle of 
pride is—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOH~!! <nickname>--!
Congratulations-!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> receiving the applause...
The vision 
drawn before her debut was steadily 
becoming reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> gave the race everything she had.
Though 
she didn't take the victory—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOH~!! <chrname>--!
That was awesome-!

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text: <chrname>... Could she perhaps be...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The fans' passion leaped beyond the 
racetrack... and continued to spread far 
and wide.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! This is it, this is what 
Umamusume racing is all about!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"A clash of everything we've got! A 
determination never to yield!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Aaah,
why didn't I go watch it in person?! 
I knew I was totally gonna regret it!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, it's settled!! Next 
year—let's sweep all the GⅠs!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Aah, Kita-chan and everyone!
I watched the 
Dream Fest!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible battle. It really 
made me want to cheer everyone on even 
harder!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, Kita-chan. Everyone's 
watching you...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm totally fired up now...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm all fired up~~~! Let's go, 
Dia-chan! Match race!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. Ohh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heat breeds even more heat—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Alright! That should be everything.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, fan letters! Please be sure to give 
them to her♪
choice_data_list: Is all of this... for Lady <chrname>?

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text: ――Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> possesses a wonderful,
magnetic charisma, 
doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text: "Befitting... the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text: I can feel it. This "Dream Fest"... no.

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
"The key to the future of the Twinkle 
Series is... <chrname>."

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Just as someone might call us 
"Legends"...—

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
"The next one to be called that might
very 
well be your Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The spotlight on <chrname> is undoubtedly
growing 
brighter. She will etch her name into 
history, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I believe you're an Umamusume capable of 
standing alongside the likes of St. Lite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Imagining her magnificent, stately 
demeanor makes my heart tremble.
choice_data_list: (That is... the sight I long to see.)
(That is... the sight I long to see.)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, hey! Wasn't that amazing? That race 
just now was just as thrilling as when 
Papa ran, wasn't it?!
choice_data_list: (That right there... is the view I...
(That right there... is the view I...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's amazing. No, honestly, I'm 
stunned. The level is so high these days."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
Records keep getting broken, the training 
environment is evolving too... Wow, it 
really is incredible.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Let's go together next time! Dad, 
you know a lot about it, right? Tell me 
all about it! Like about Umamusume from 
back in the day!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Back then—... I see. Has that much 
time really passed?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
Back with "that girl," it didn't come 
true, but...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
"—If she keeps evolving like this, she 
might eventually reach it... the 'world.'"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you. See you soon.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Speed Symboli-san, your 
English is quite fluent as well.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I've been studying since my active days. 
I'd be in trouble if I hadn't gotten 
better by now.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Haiseiko-kun. It seems things 
are about to get interesting again.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"If you take action,
the era and the world 
will change...
The view before our eyes is 
proof of that."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that "someday" will surely come. 
As long as we continue to strive...—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Because the future is always where hope 
lies.
